nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text: 🟠The National Orientation Agency (NOA) in #Nigeria#Nigerians #Nigeria has initiated a nationwide campaign to educate citizens about Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV).

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠According to Dr. Olufemi Ayoola, NOA’s director of health and social care, the effort is proactive, with no reported cases of #HMPV in the country. 
The campaign aims to provide accurate information and prevent misinformation about the respiratory virus.

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠The #Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (#NCDC) is collaborating with the #NOA to spread awareness, particularly in rural communities. 
The campaign will include accurate messaging and health education to prepare the public for any potential risks.
